title: One step of the unary scan
statement: Let $B$ be a language of bit strings, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $j<|x|$ with the bit of $x$ at position $j$ equal to $1$. If $u$ is a bit string of length $j$ and $b$ is a bit, then the designated oracle machine, started in its scan configuration at position $j$ with buffer $u$, takes one step with choice $b$ to the scan configuration at position $j+1$ with buffer $u$ followed by $b$.

the bit of x at position j is true
u is a bit string with |u| = j
